A Riftborn humanoid who fell through the Veil from a war-torn world and found the Severed Lands a paradise of unguarded settlements. Rift-raiders organize in warbands, striking outlying farms and waystations with weapons forged from scavenged Warden alloys. They wear trophies taken from Returner patrols as badges of conquest.
## Traits
**Innate Spellcasting.** INT (DC 11). 3/day: jump, misty step. 1/day: plane shift (self only).

## Actions
**Multiattack.** Two greatsword attacks.
**Greatsword.** +4 to hit, 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing + 7 (2d6) psychic.
